data.explanation: Your internet provider Netzwelt Beispiel GmbH is raising the monthly price of your "Netzwelt DSL 100" tariff from €44.99 to €49.99, starting 1 June 2026. Because this is a price increase, German telecom law (§ 57 Abs. 1 TKG) gives you a special right to cancel the contract without notice period and without extra cost. The app will show you until when this special cancellation right lasts, counted from when you received this letter. You don't have to do anything if you're fine with the new price; if you want to cancel, send your cancellation to the provider before that window closes.
